name: High School Athlete
description: Varsity sports. Strong and durable, but bookwork was never your priority.

name: Team Captain
description: Led a team or club. Natural leader with quick feet, but the long haul wears on you.

name: Honor Student
description: Strong academics. Sharp mind, but you skipped gym more than you'd admit.

name: JROTC
description: Prior drill exposure. Disciplined and coordinated, light on classroom edge.

name: Manual Labor
description: Physical job background. Built tough from work, not from giving orders.

name: Student Council
description: Organized peers and ran meetings. Smart and persuasive, not the most athletic.
